content:
maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding Aether-8B (fp16 -> q4o) shows generation drift only after ~2k tokens; summarization Rouge-L and a few synthesis tests fail. Not CPU perf related.
eli: can you post the export command + one failing example?
maya: export: `./export_model --model aether-8b --quant q4o --preset perf` 
failed case: long doc summarization where repeated clauses appear and content drifts off-topic after token ~2100.
ci-bot: Export job: exports/aether8b-q4o #6135791111  3 failed, 9 passed  logs at /ci/exports/6135791111/logs
toby: suspicious: some converters normalize rotary scaling via a "rotary_scale" or "rotary_base" field; presets sometimes snap base to 10000. That changes angular frequencies and can slowly diverge in long autoregressions.
anya: also check tokenizer normalization: if hosted path applies NFKC but embedded uses NFD, combined diacritics or ligatures inside long paragraphs can re-segment tokens, shifting KV alignment.
maya: artifact config shows: {"rotary_base":10000,"head_permute":"interleave","tokenizer_norm":"NFKC"} hub config: {"rotary_base":8192,"head_permute":"native","tokenizer_norm":"preserve"}
eli: there it is. head_permute + rotary_base + tokenizer_norm changed. Any chance preset altered head order for packing?
maya: preset includes `pack_interleave=true` and `snap_rotary_base=true` (didn't realize).
toby: repro plan: (1) re-export with `--preserve-rotary-base --preserve-head-order --tokenizer=embedded`; (2) dump deterministic logits for same seed for 512 and 4096 tokens and compute per-token L2 and KL vs fp16 baseline; (3) run token parity across long inputs to detect resegmentation.
anya: add unit tests in exporter: assert rotary_base equality and head_permute preserved, and a tokenizer-parity integration that feeds long paragraphs (>4k chars).
maya: rerun queued with preserve flags now. Kicking off. :rocket:
ci-bot: Rerun started: exports/aether8b-q4o-rerun (#6135791111-rerun)
eli: also check whether q4o math path fused rotary precompute using fp16; that rounding can accumulate. If export fused sin/cos into kernel with lower precision, we should disable fusion for long-context tests.
toby: good point. add check for rotary_precision in metadata.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: 0 failed, 12 passed  artifacts at /ci/exports/6135791180/results
maya: rerun numbers: Rouge-L fp16=40.2, q4o-preserve=39.9  delta small. Root cause = preset snapping rotary_base + head permute + tokenizer norm.
anya: action items: (1) export e2e asserts for rotary_base/head_order/rotary_precision/tokenizer_norm; (2) document presets that mutate metadata as opt-in; (3) add long-context tokenizer parity test to onboarding checklist.
eli: will open PR for asserts. toby, can you add the long-context parity harness?
toby: on it. Closing the onboarding ticket and noting preset caveat in the model doc. :white_check_mark:
